Detailed Description

Public C++17 SDK for Slamhaus WebAssembly pages.

The SDK exposes browser capabilities through small, renderer-agnostic value types and platform helpers. Applications can include this header in native tests; browser-only operations become safe no-ops outside Emscripten.
